question: Gram stain is based on:

options.opa: The presence of mycolic acids in the bacterial cell wall.
options.opb: The presence of capsule in some bacteria.
options.opc: The different composition of the cell wall of Gram + and - bacteria.
options.opd: The presence of spores in some bacteria.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: The Gram stain differentiates bacteria based on the different composition of the cell wall of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria -> The stain involves crystal violet and safranin -> Gram-positive bacteria retain the crystal violet dye due to their thicker peptidoglycan layer -> Gram-negative bacteria are counterstained pink by safranin -> The staining results are observed under a microscope -> 95%
analysis: Gram stain is based on the different composition of the cell wall of Gram + and - bacteria.
